# Techinvesteraren: Starka rapporter väntas för molnbolagen

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-07-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts discuss the upcoming earnings season for the large US cloud/Magnificent Seven names, with one host bullish on continued strong hyperscaler demand and Microsoft's upcoming full-year guidance, while the other has turned cautious, trimming Microsoft and Amazon and exiting Meta due to weak share-price momentum despite expected strong fundamentals. The conversation centers on rising capex from hyperscalers driven by AI token consumption and data-center demand, and a broader debate about whether market perception of these stocks will improve alongside earnings.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 MSFT — Microsoft | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong cloud demand and order backlog expected to show up in full-year guidance at end of July, but one host has already trimmed the position on weak technical momentum.

#### Reasoning

Host 1 expects very strong demand for cloud services given a trillion-dollar order backlog across hyperscalers and rising capex driven by AI token consumption; host 2 agrees the report will likely be strong but has reduced exposure because the stock isn't showing technical momentum versus the index, and is unsure market perception will shift even on good results.

#### Sell Triggers

- if full-year guidance disappoints
- if share price fails to regain relative momentum vs index after earnings

> *"Jag har skilt från ingen faktiskt minskat i dem. Jag har inte meta längre. Jag har gått ner i Microsoft, Amazon"*

---

### 🟠 AMZN — Amazon | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Grouped with Microsoft as a cloud beneficiary of hyperscaler capex growth, but position has been reduced due to lack of price momentum.

#### Reasoning

Expected to benefit from continued hyperscaler capex increases tied to AI infrastructure buildout, but host 2 has cut exposure because the stock hasn't shown the technical strength he requires alongside fundamentals.

#### Sell Triggers

- if capex growth from hyperscalers slows
- if stock continues to underperform index

> *"Jag har gått ner i Microsoft, Amazon och anledningen är att de levererar inte på börsen."*

---

### 🟢 GOOGL — Alphabet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Part of a trio (with Microsoft and Amazon) that the host has bought heavily into ahead of expected strong June-quarter cloud reports.

#### Reasoning

Host 1 has built a large position across the major cloud players including Alphabet, expecting very strong demand for cloud services driven by a trillion-dollar combined order backlog and rising AI-driven data-center spend.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cloud order backlog growth stalls
- if quarterly report misses demand expectations

> *"Vi har kört på oss rätt ordentligt med Microsoft, Amazon och Alphabet."*

---

### ⛔ META — Meta | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host has fully exited Meta as part of a broader reduction in Magnificent Seven names due to weak stock momentum.

#### Reasoning

Host 2 prefers to trade stocks with good momentum in both fundamentals and technicals; Meta no longer meets that bar and has been sold entirely, alongside reductions in Microsoft and Amazon.

#### Sell Triggers

- improvement in relative price momentum vs index

> *"Jag har inte meta längre."*
